group_norms.norm_text: We all prefer in-person listening sessions to virtual ones.
Vinyl is the primary format; digital is acceptable but secondary.
Original pressings are valued more than reissues for a serious collection.
We share repair tips freely and never charge each other for help.
We do post-meetup dinners together at a chosen restaurant.
